sources.title: agent-manager README
sources.finding: Local terminal app over tmux running thirteen coding CLIs side by side with live status, quick prompt, worktrees, diff review, MCP delegation between agents, SSH connections; macOS, Linux, Windows via psmux and WSL2; Apache-2.0; cost tracking not here yet.

sources.title: Usage guide
sources.locator: Keys; Quick prompt mode; Worktree sessions; Killing and reviving; MCP; Diff review; Groups; SSH connections; Status; Notifications; Stats
sources.finding: Reference for every key, session lifecycle, worktrees, revive by conversation id, MCP tools, review comments, status states, notification command and host stats.

sources.title: Configuration guide
sources.locator: Export and import; Agent CLIs; Key bindings
sources.finding: Settings live in SQLite state.db; export and import of settings, presets, groups and connections as JSON; per-CLI notes; all CLI rules are built into the binary.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.finding: Go packages: Bubble Tea UI, sessioncmd, mcpserver, store (SQLite), tmux driver, status classifier, poller; delivery is at most once.

sources.title: SSH connections
sources.finding: A connection lists another host's agent-manager sessions; control flows over ssh batch mode to the remote CLI; remote manager keeps running headless via serve --background.

sources.title: Install guide
sources.finding: Installers for macOS, Linux and Windows; requires tmux 3.1+ (psmux 3.4+ on Windows) and git.

sources.title: Security policy
sources.finding: Documents generated agent config, stdio MCP server scoped to the caller session, local SQLite state, and the two unauthenticated GET requests at startup and every 10 minutes (releases and message feed).

sources.title: Governance
sources.finding: Single maintainer with collaborators; roadmap board; code-owner review enforced.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0
sources.finding: Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: agent-manager v0.49.0 release
sources.finding: Assets for darwin, linux and windows on amd64 and arm64 plus checksums.txt, install.sh and install.ps1; published 2026-11-14.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 699 stars, Apache-2.0, last push 2026-11-16, created 2026-07-15, homepage agent-manager.dev; repository previously at YoanWai/agent-manager.

sources.title: agent-manager site llms.txt
sources.finding: Describes a Go TUI on tmux for running thirteen coding CLIs, local developer tool, not a hosted service; no pricing.

sources.title: Go module
sources.finding: Go module with Bubble Tea, lipgloss, modernc.org/sqlite, go-sdk for MCP and gopsutil; no HTTP server framework.

sources.title: Built-in CLI definitions
sources.finding: Launch, resume, fork, MCP registration and status rules for the thirteen CLIs are compiled into the binary.

sources.title: MCP server
sources.finding: stdio MCP server with rename, review, list_sessions, create_session, read_session, send_session, message_status, wait_for_session, revive/kill/archive/move/delete_session, task, reserve_files, groups and terminal tools, report_issue.

sources.title: Task and reservation tables
sources.finding: SQLite tables for a shared task list with owner, state pending/claimed/done and dependencies, advisory file reservations with expiry, and an inbox for agent messages.

sources.title: Task claim
sources.finding: Claim is one guarded write that refuses a blocked or already claimed task; ClaimNextTask takes the oldest unblocked pending task.

sources.title: task subcommands
sources.finding: CLI task list, create (with --depends-on), claim, finish, release and delete run as the caller session.

sources.title: Agent messages
sources.finding: Messages are queued rather than typed at once, capped at 8000 bytes with queue and per-sender rate caps and a fingerprint to stop loops.

sources.title: Spawn path
sources.finding: One spawn path for form, quick bar, CLI and MCP: opens the requested worktree, launches, hands the worktree back on failure.

sources.title: Worktree creation
sources.finding: Creates <repo>-worktrees/<name> on branch am/<name> from the detected base.

sources.title: Claude Code status hooks
sources.finding: Generated --settings file makes Claude Code write lifecycle state into a per-session status file read ahead of pane rules.

sources.title: Status classifier
sources.finding: Per-tool regex rules over the visible pane classify working, waiting, finished, errored, idle, dead, starting.

sources.title: Poller
sources.finding: UI-free poller captures panes every two seconds, delivers messages, runs notifications and after-turn archive or kill.

sources.title: tmux driver
sources.finding: Sessions run on a private tmux server named agentmgr; a control-mode client streams the focused pane.

sources.title: Remote host driver
sources.finding: Drives another host's agent-manager CLI over ssh with BatchMode and ControlMaster; starts serve --background there.

sources.title: Update check
sources.finding: Reads GitHub Releases for newer versions and in-place self-update with checksum verification.

sources.title: Message feed
sources.finding: Fetches docs/messages.json from raw.githubusercontent.com on main for in-app notices.

sources.title: Release and feed ticks
sources.finding: Checks run at startup and every 10 minutes while open.

sources.title: Review mode
sources.finding: Full-file diffs with scopes uncommitted, branch target, commit, staged; draft comments, numbered rounds sent to the agent, reviewed marks per scope persisted in SQLite.

sources.title: notify command
sources.finding: User shell command run for each notification with AM_* environment, 15 second timeout, logged on failure.

sources.title: Environment profiles
sources.finding: Named environment variable sets stored in state.db and exported in the pane before the CLI starts.

sources.title: snapshot --json
sources.finding: Machine-readable list of sessions, terminals, groups and whether a manager runs; versioned envelope.

sources.title: Host stats
sources.finding: CPU, memory, swap, disk, battery, network and temperature gauges, plus per-agent process tree CPU and RAM.

sources.title: agent-manager skill
sources.finding: Skill file that teaches an agent the spawn, status, answer and review procedure.

sources.title: Roadmap: Cost and usage tracking
sources.finding: Status Later: per session and group tokens, cost and plan limits across CLIs; today only CPU and RAM.

sources.title: Roadmap: Phone access
sources.finding: Status Later: check on and answer agents from a phone, native app or terminal over SSH, details open.

sources.title: Roadmap: Plugins and a plugin marketplace
sources.finding: Status Next: plugins from a marketplace of verified plugins, open questions pending spikes.

sources.title: Roadmap: Lifecycle hooks
sources.finding: Status Next: run user commands on session start, state change, archive, task claim or review round; replaces notify_command.

sources.title: Roadmap: Agent presets and orchestration
sources.finding: Status Later: save an agent setup as a preset; one preset is an orchestrator that plans work and starts other sessions.
